# SYNESIS_E099 — Warning

## Description

`MAP` is not accepted in this format.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: this format does not use `MAP` lines.
  `MAP RELATIONS` is accepted in SKOS and `MAP <fields> TO` in ALPACA (and in CNA,
  when that format is available). Remove the line.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MapNotSupported**: `block`
